prompts.overtaking:
Use case: scientific-educational / style-transfer.
Create one landscape 3:2 educational windsurfing scene, high resolution, for a hover illustration on the Cal Sailing Club handbook.
The supplied port/starboard image is a STYLE reference only. Match its painterly turquoise water, feathered white outer edges, crisp navy outlines, soft depth/shadows, blue/orange boards, lime-and-white sails, cream callouts with orange edges, and dark navy serif labels.
Exactly TWO windsurfers, A and B, each with ONE slim windsurf board, attached mast/boom and triangular sail, and a small simplified sailor in a dark wetsuit and flotation vest holding the boom. Direct overhead view. Distinct pointed bow and squared tail; navy travel arrows agree with each board's nose. Large clean labels never overlap people, sails or arrows. No dinghies, docks, extra boards, compass letters, watermark or webpage mockup.
Wind ALWAYS comes from the TOP and blows straight DOWN: three large parallel downward navy arrows at upper center with the word "Wind". Sails and sailors must be on plausible leeward/windward sides for that wind. Preserve generous separation between boards.
Label A with an orange-accented cream tag "A — GIVE WAY"; label B with a navy-accented cream tag "B — STAND ON". Color is reinforced by text. The image explains which windsurfer keeps clear, not a mandatory passing maneuver. Show only short straight heading arrows, no curved evasive paths, no crossed leader lines.

Title: "Overtaking".
Both windsurfers sail horizontally RIGHT, both on port tack, in the same lane. A is BEHIND on the LEFT of B, approaching B from directly astern. Put A around the left third and B around the right third of the image, both at the same height. Their bows both point RIGHT, and both sails are on the lower/downwind side. A's short forward travel arrow is longer than B's to convey faster approach. Show A clearly catching up from behind, never alongside or ahead.
Place the A give-way label near the rear/left windsurfer with a second line "Overtaking". Place the B stand-on label near the leading/right windsurfer with a second line "Being overtaken".
Bottom cream strip text exactly: "The overtaking windsurfer keeps clear."
